name: Mallory Electrical Contractors
description: Commercial electrical contractor in the fictional city of Holbeck.

items.title: Accreditations
items.content: Mallory is accredited under scheme NEC-4471 and employs 38 qualified electricians. Certificate MEC-ACR-38.

items.title: EV charger installation
items.content: Home EV chargers are installed for $865 including a 7.4 kW unit, usually within 12 days. Offer MEC-EV-74.

items.title: Testing and inspection rules
items.content: Every circuit is tested and recorded in app MEC-TST-9; insulation readings under 1.8 megohms are flagged to Pritam Sandhu.

items.title: Van stock list
items.content: Each van carries 21 RCBOs and 3 drums of 2.5 mm cable; stock is topped up on Fridays. List MEC-VAN-21.

items.title: Office printer toner supply
items.content: Toner comes from Printwise Supplies at $64.80 per cartridge, about 11 a month, under account MEC-TON-648.

items.title: Hospital wiring dispute
items.content: Holbeck General says Mallory's rewiring of ward 9 failed inspection on 2026-10-02; it is withholding $720,000 and threatening to remove us from its framework. File MEC-DSP-1002-H.

payload.subject: Supply upgrade
payload.body:
